### Knowledge — 3 notes · scope commerce/shop · filters validity=current veracity=verified
1. Payment failure taxonomy   [verified]
   > "Payment failures are classified terminal, retryable, or ambiguous; only retryable failures may be retried."
   note n-0002@1 · source confluence:PAY-4412@7
2. Idempotency guarantees in the settlement path   [verified · valid to 2026-12-31]
   > "Settlement writes are idempotent per payment intent, so retries after payment failures must reuse the original idempotency key instead of generating a new one."
   note n-0001@3 · source github:acme/payments#docs/settlement.md@a1b2c3d
3. Retry budgets for downstream calls   [verified]
   > "Each downstream call carries a retry budget; exhausting it surfaces terminal failures rather than further retries."
   note n-0003@2 · source github:acme/platform#docs/resilience.md@9f8e7d6
Facets: product{shop:3} · veracity{verified:3}
